Pandoc 3.12
===========

AriadShift includes Pandoc, John MacFarlane's document converter (https://pandoc.org),
to export documents as Word (.docx) and to read and write other formats.

Version:   3.12 (git tag 3.12, commit 381230ee36d8fa871c28f8982e22579f1a8f723b)
Licence:   GNU General Public License, version 2 or later (GPL-2.0-or-later)
Binary:    the unmodified official macOS release, pandoc-3.12-arm64-macOS.zip and
           pandoc-3.12-x86_64-macOS.zip from
           https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/releases/tag/3.12, joined into one universal
           file at Contents/Helpers/pandoc
Source:    https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/tree/3.12
           https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/archive/refs/tags/3.12.tar.gz

Pandoc is a separate program. AriadShift starts it as a child process and exchanges
documents with it through files and pipes; it is not linked into AriadShift or into the
ashift helper. AriadShift's own code stays under its own licence (see NOTICE).

The licence texts that come with this release sit beside this file, unchanged from the
3.12 tag:
  COPYING.txt   the GNU General Public License (upstream file COPYING.md)
  COPYRIGHT     Pandoc's copyright and licence notice, including code it carries under
                other licences
